arcs.title: The Duck Waits
arcs.summary: New arc to open in the next day or two. The duck on the Jeep's mirror has been facing north-northeast since Steve restored it Saturday. The Ministry's subcommittee noted it appears to be 'waiting.' A new duck — different colour, different posture — will be found on the Jeep within the next edition or two, left by the Duck Bandit. The arc will trace the slow revelation of who the Bandit is, what they know about the ridge, and whether the original duck is somehow involved. Day 1 should be the discovery of the new duck.
